0022600145.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-3) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (0-3) in a meeting of two winless teams, with Sacramento on a three-game losing streak and 15th in the West while New Orleans sits 14th. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle) and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost 1-2, though Sacramento won the most recent regular-season meeting 117-113 on April 3, 2026 in Sacramento.
